issues.description: Attribute 'numberOfLecturers' has conflicting types across artifacts. The problem statement UML lists 'numberOfLecturers' as type int (problem_statement.md, lines 63-68). The reference solution declares the field as 'private byte numberOfLecturers;' (solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, line 9), the constructor and setter use a byte parameter (constructor signature at line 13, setter signature at line 50), but the getter is declared to return int (getter signature at line 46). This inconsistent choice (byte field + byte setter/constructor vs. int in UML and an int-returning getter) can confuse students about the intended attribute type and expected API signatures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute type and all accessor/constructor signatures consistent with the specification. Prefer changing the solution to use 'int numberOfLecturers' (update the field declaration, constructor parameter and setter to int) so it matches the UML and the getter signature, or alternatively change the UML/problem statement to 'byte' and update the getter to return byte. Ensure field type, constructor parameter type, getter return type and setter parameter type all match.
